Game Overview

Car Battle is a action game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Car Battle doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Car Battle?

Car Battle is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Car Battle free to play?

Yes, Car Battle is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
